_readme: EDIT THE `profile` OF EACH SEARCH FIRST — it is the text the model scores every posting against. Each entry in `searches` is an independent track with its own profile and keywords; they share one network pass, so adding a track costs no extra fetching. Copy a block to add your own.

searches.name: Product design internships
searches.profile: Student or recent graduate looking for a product design internship. Works in Figma, can run a design process end to end — research, wireframes, prototypes, handoff — and has a portfolio with two or three case studies. Open to remote internships worldwide or on-site in my own city. No visa sponsorship, so an internship requiring relocation abroad is a poor fit unless the posting says it sponsors. Not a graphic design, motion or brand-only role — this is product/UX work on digital products.

searches.name: Product design roles
searches.profile: Early-career product designer looking for a first or second full-time role — junior, associate, mid-level or an entry-level design position. Strong in Figma, design systems, prototyping and usability testing; comfortable working with engineers. Open to remote worldwide or on-site in my own city. No visa sponsorship available. Not looking for senior, lead or management positions, and not graphic/brand/marketing design.

sources._companies_help: The slug is the last part of the company's job-board URL: boards.greenhouse.io/SLUG, jobs.lever.co/SLUG, jobs.ashbyhq.com/SLUG. Every slug below is verified working and posts design roles. A company that hosts its own careers page has no public API and cannot be added.
